title: FDA Licenses First-Ever Freeze-Dried Plasma Product in the U.S.
excerpt: FDA today licensed Ezplaz Freeze Dried Plasma (FDP), making it the first freeze-dried plasma product licensed for use in the United States. Ezplaz is intended for transfusion in adult patients who need plasma and for whom other plasma products are not available.
